## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature / enhancement (non-breaking improvement)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (README, docs, examples)
- [ ] 🎨 Styling / Branding / Asset refinement
- [ ] 🛡️ Security / Hardening improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have executed `bash tests/validate.sh` locally and all 8 validation gates pass.
- [ ] Manifest versions and schemas remain completely synchronized.
- [ ] Cognitive structuring invariants (Miller's law: 4–7 branches, depth 3–4, brevity ≤ 8 words) are preserved in `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] No private data, PII, credentials, or `.env` files are tracked (`git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard` is empty).
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated.
